delete.title: Title of the dialog that deletes a promoted app. {{name}} is its name.
delete.description: The dialog's text. The launcher is the list of apps people open.
delete.data: Heading of the choice of what happens to the app's data.
delete.keep-named: Under that choice: {{datasets}} lists the app's datasets' names.
delete.keep-detail: Under that choice, when the datasets' names aren't known.
delete.remove: Choice: delete the datasets made when the app was promoted.
delete.delete: Destructive button that deletes the app.
delete.deleted: Toast after deleting. {{name}} is the app's name.
delete.deleted-with: Toast after deleting it with its datasets. {{datasets}} lists their names.
unregister.title: Title of the dialog that unregisters an app. {{name}} is its name.
unregister.action: Destructive button that unregisters the app.
logs.title: Title of the dialog with an app's logs. {{name}} is the app's name.
logs.description: The dialog's text. The workspace app runtime runs promoted apps.
logs.load-failed: Error toast when the logs could not load.
logs.none: Shown when there are no logs.
logs.attempt: Label of the list of build and start attempts.
logs.choose: Disabled first choice of that list.
logs.option: One attempt in the list: {{attempt}} its number, {{label}} what it was and how it ended, {{when}} when it started.
logs.no-output: Shown when an attempt printed nothing.
logs.started: When the attempt started ({{when}}, a date and time).
logs.answered: When the app first answered ({{when}}); follows a ·.
logs.ended: When the attempt ended ({{when}}); follows a ·.
logs.dropped: First line of the log when older lines weren't kept. Keep the square brackets.
attempt.label: An attempt: a build or a start of a version ({{version}}), and how it went ({{how}}, one of attempt.*).
attempt.running: How an attempt went: the app started and runs.
attempt.in-progress: How an attempt went: still going.
attempt.done: How an attempt went: it worked.
attempt.oom: How an attempt went: it ran out of memory.
attempt.never-answered: How an attempt went: the app never answered its health check.
attempt.lost: How an attempt went: nobody knows how it ended.
attempt.stopped: How an attempt went: it was stopped.
attempt.exit: How an attempt went: it failed with an exit code ({{code}}, a number).
attempt.signal: How an attempt went: it was killed by a signal ({{signal}}, like SIGKILL).
attempt.failed: How an attempt went: it failed.
